novelty_flags.label: prop:two-arm-reduction
novelty_flags.one_line: The scalar binomial experiment and its n^{-1}-C_A n^{-4/3}+o(n^{-4/3}) expansion are already proved by sudijono_dobriban_tchetgen_2026_sharp; retain this only as a regression clause, not as a root contribution.

soundness_flags.label: def:first-order-procedure and thm:first-order-saddle
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed centered HT rule can leave [-L_c/2,L_c/2], while the minimax action space defining rho_n contains only clipped estimators; explicitly compose it with projection onto that interval, or enlarge the action space and prove clipping is lossless.

soundness_flags.label: C_{\mathrm{so}}(c) and oeq:second-order-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: C_{\mathrm{so}}(c) is globally typed as a positive limit constant even though the question permits that no regularly varying normalization exists; define it conditionally in the existence branch.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper reduces the binary two-arm SATE minimax problem to X=p+Binomial(r,1/2), proves unrestricted-design equality, and gives rho_n^*=n^{-1}-C_A n^{-4/3}+o(n^{-4/3}) with C_A=1.617... .

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Bai proves a permutation-invariance randomization result and then restricts the optimal-estimation analysis to quadratic loss and linear estimators.
The paper evaluates multi-arm shrinker allocation through approximate-normal risks expressed as expectations of Gaussian quadratic-form ratios and proposes sequential adaptive allocation.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Move the two-arm Airy statement out of the root statements into the K=2 sanity clause of the new multi-arm theorem, retaining its exact published formula as a regression requirement.
Define the first-order attaining rule as the projected centered HT estimator and state the projection-loss argument once, so it is an admissible action in the same minimax game.
Add a worked K=3 certificate for one small n and M: exhibit the exact rational primal/dual values and identify which response-type and allocation faces bind before advancing the continuum analysis.

Make the second-order headline compare the eventual multi-face value problem explicitly with both named two-arm unrestricted routes (Sudijono--Dobriban--Tchetgen Tchetgen and Hull), including a precise criterion that distinguishes scalar separation from a genuinely multidimensional limit.

recommended_next_step: Repair the two action-space/conditional-constant definitions and demote the published two-arm proposition to a regression clause; then continue with the genuinely new K>=3 orbit and second-order targets.
